summary: SEALSQ Corp, a British Virgin Islands foreign private issuer, furnished a routine Form 6-K that solely designates certain previously furnished Forms 6-K as incorporated by reference into its existing Form F-3 shelf registration statements (File Nos. 333-286098 and 333-290874) and related prospectuses. No securities are offered, priced, or sold in this filing, and no transaction, stakeholder, or board action is disclosed. The report is signed by CEO Carlos Moreira and CFO John O'Hara. This is administrative shelf-maintenance housekeeping with no deal terms; nothing for a risk-arb angle.
